result.topic_en: Notes on Abelian functions (August–September 1855): the local expansion of a function near a branch point, its periodicity moduli and jumps across the sides of a period rectangle, and conditions $du_\iota=0$ expressed as ratios of the differentials $du_1:du_2:\dots:du_n$.
result.transcription:
Abel'sche Functionen, August und September 1855.
$s = [-\ldots-]\log(u_{\iota''}-\beta_{\iota''\iota}) + c_{\iota''\iota} + c'_{\iota''\iota}(u_{\iota''}-\beta_{\iota''\iota}) + \frac{c''_{\iota''\iota}}{2}(u_{\iota''}-\beta_{\iota''\iota})^2$
$\frac{\partial \overset{\iota,3}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} - \frac{\partial \overset{\iota,1}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} = \frac{\partial \overset{\iota,4}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} - \frac{\partial \overset{\iota,2}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} = -2$
$\frac{\partial \overset{\iota',3}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} \ldots\ldots = 0 \quad \iota' \gtrless \iota$
$\frac{\partial \overset{\iota',2}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} - \frac{\partial \overset{\iota',1}{s}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} = 0$
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial \alpha_\iota} = \frac{1}{u_{\iota''}-\beta_{\iota''\iota'}} \cdot \frac{\partial \beta_{\iota''\iota'}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} - \gamma_{\iota''\iota'} \cdot \frac{1}{\Delta}\frac{\partial \Delta}{\partial \alpha_{\iota\iota'}} + \frac{\partial c_{\iota''\iota'}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} - c'_{\iota''\iota'} \gamma_{\iota''\iota'} \frac{\partial t_{\iota'}}{\partial \alpha_\iota} [-\ldots-] + c'$
$\overset{\iota,3}{w} - \overset{\iota,1}{w} = (2u_{\iota}+a_{\iota\iota}[-\ldots-]) + c_{\iota}[?] \quad \overset{\iota,4}{w} - \overset{\iota,2}{w} = (2\overset{\iota,2}{u_{\iota}}+a_{\iota,\iota}+c_\iota)$
[Figur: Rechteck mit Ecken $\iota,1$; $\iota,2$; $\iota,4$; $\iota,3$, innen kleine Beschriftung]
$\overset{\iota',3}{w} - \overset{\iota',1}{w} = c_{\iota'} = \overset{\iota',4}{w} - \overset{\iota',2}{w}$
$\overset{\iota',2}{w} - \overset{\iota',1}{w} = 0 = \overset{\iota',4}{w} - \overset{\iota',3}{w} \quad \iota' \gtrless \iota$
$\overset{\iota,4}{w} - \overset{\iota,3}{w} = 0. \quad \overset{\iota,2}{w} - \overset{\iota,1}{w} = -2b_{\iota,\iota'}$ \quad $w = [-\ldots-]\frac{b_{\iota,\iota'}}{\pi i}\log(z-\beta) + $ continuirn[?].
$\int w\, du_{\iota'}$ durch die ganze Begrenzung von T. $\pi i\, c_{\iota\iota'}$
$\left(\int_{\iota,3}^{\iota,4} + \int_{\iota,2}^{\iota,1}\right) w\, du_\iota =$
$\int$
$du_\iota = 0 \quad u_\iota = p_{\iota,\iota',\iota} \quad \iota' \gtrless \iota$
$= q_{\iota,\iota',\iota} \quad \iota' \gtrless \iota$
$u_{\iota''} = p_{\iota,\iota',\iota''} \Big| \iota' \gtrless \iota,\ du_\iota = 0 \Big\{ du_1 : du_2 : \ldots\ du_n \Big| u_{\iota''} = p_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$
$= q_{\iota,\iota',\iota''} \Big| \qquad \Big\{ q_{\iota,\iota',1} : q_{\iota,\iota',2} \ldots$
$q_{\iota,\iota',\iota} = 0 \cdot h_{\iota,\iota',\iota} = 0 \quad \frac{du_1 : du_2}{h_{\iota,\iota',1} : h_{\iota,\iota',2}} \Big| u_{\iota''} = q_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$
---
$du_\iota = 0 \quad du_1 : du_2 : \ldots\ du_n$
$q_{\iota,1,e} : q_{\iota,2,e} \cdots q_{\iota,n,e} \qquad e = 1,2,\ldots,2(n-1)$

methods.what: Local expansion of s near a branch point: logarithmic term plus power series in $(u-\beta)$
Jumps of derivative of s with respect to parameter across cut edges
Periodicity moduli (jumps) of w across the edges of the period rectangle
Local form of w near a singular point: logarithm with coefficient $b/\pi i$ plus continuous part
Integral of $w\,du$ around the whole boundary of T equals $\pi i c$ (boundary integration method)
methods.quote: $\int w\, du_{\iota'}$ durch die ganze Begrenzung von T. $\pi i\, c_{\iota\iota'}$

methods.what: Points where $du_\iota=0$ and the corresponding ratios of differentials, $2(n-1)$ such points
